name: issue_1433_away_grace_periodic_cycle_holds_home
description: Issue #1433: on a cold day with the windows closed, a 30-minute cycle that lands inside the 15-minute away timer must not send the away setback (heat 60 F); after each return home every periodic cycle keeps the home band (heat 70 F); while really away the periodic cycle keeps the setback.
source: production log 2026-11-07 (Zone 1, 11:23:12 'Away mode - reapplying setback' 4.5 min after leaving at 11:18:46; nothing sent, windows open)
notes: Occupant outcome: you step out for 12 minutes on a cold morning (or a phone's presence drops for a few minutes). Climate Advisor promises a 15-minute grace before the away setback, but a 30-minute cycle that lands in that grace set the heat to 60 F at once; the house cooled until you came back. After coming home, every later cycle must keep the 70 F comfort heat.

Drives the REAL occupancy toggle (home_toggle_entity) through the coordinator's own listener and its real 15-minute away timer, and the periodic 30-minute cycle as a classification event (the cycle's apply_classification(), as every golden models it), so the timer-pending state production is in is modelled, not skipped.

Two Away periods, as on 2026-11-07: the first is a short errand (back after 12 minutes, inside the timer), the second is longer (the timer applies the setback). A periodic cycle runs inside the timer, after each return, and while really away (the leaving mirror: the cycle must not undo Away).
(a) Scenario effectiveness: on 0.9.7 the 09:06 cycle writes heat 60 inside the timer, so the empty-writes assertion at 09:11 fails (EXPECTED FAIL before the fix).

(b) Docs <-> production: docs/occupancy-dispatch-spec.md (State Transitions: 'setback fires on expiry'; 30-Minute Poll Guards) and docs/chart-log-spec.md (#1425: the home band is drawn while the timer runs) say the setback waits for the timer.
(c) User outcome if this regresses: brief absences and presence flaps set the heat back while the household expects comfort; the chart draws the home band while the thermostat holds the setback.

events.note: cold morning, indoor just under the 70 F comfort floor
leave for a 12-minute errand: the 15-minute away timer starts
the 30-minute cycle (apply_classification): a periodic 30-minute cycle lands inside the away timer
back home after 12 minutes: the timer is cancelled, no setback was due
the 30-minute cycle (apply_classification): first periodic cycle after the first return
leave again: the timer applies the setback at 10:15
the 30-minute cycle (apply_classification): periodic cycle while really away (leaving mirror)
the 30-minute cycle (apply_classification): first periodic cycle after the second return

assertions.reason: precondition: home, cold day, comfort heat 70 F on the thermostat
THE FIX: inside the 15-minute away timer the periodic cycle sends nothing (before the fix it sent heat 60 F at 09:06)
after the first return the thermostat holds comfort heat 70 F
after the first return every write is the home 70 F (the 09:36 periodic cycle), never the 60 F setback
the away timer applied the setback (heat 60 F) at 10:15
leaving mirror: the periodic cycle while away keeps the setback, it does not undo Away
coming home restores comfort heat 70 F
after the second return the periodic cycle writes the home 70 F, never the setback
the armed band after the second return is the home band (floor 70 F), not the 60 F setback

verdict.summary: Issue #1433: the away setback waits for the 15-minute timer; after every return each periodic cycle keeps the home band
verdict.expected_behavior: no write inside the away timer; 70 F after each return; 60 F while really away
